[SWS_EthSwt_00512] Behaviour if EthSwtMacAddressLearningMode is set to
SVL
Upstream requirements: SRS_Eth_00087
⌈If EthSwtMacAddressLearningMode is set to SVL, then the EthSwt driver shall
consider the given the MAC-address and ignore the given VLAN-ID to determine the
MAC-address to Ethernet port assignment.⌋
Note: If EthSwtMacAddressLearningMode is set to SVL, the MAC-address to port
assignment is shared across all VLANs and therefore the given VLAN is ignored.
